segments.text: V. 27. Even what I now tell you ſ••rc•ly, is not to be kept ſecret long, but declared publickly▪ Therefore what ye hear in the ear, pab•iſh on the houſ••t p— Two Cuſtoms of the Jews ſeem to be alluded to here. Their Doctors uſed to whiſper in the Ear of their Diſciples, what they were to pronounce aloud to others. And as their Houſes were low and flat-roo•ed, they ſometimes preached to the People from thence.
